```{r}
library(ggplot2)

mining_by_year <- df %>%
  select(starts_with("land_cover_")) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(. == "Mining", na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Mining_Pixels"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(gsub("land_cover_", "", Year))
  )

ggplot(mining_by_year,
       aes(x = Year, y = Mining_Pixels)) +
  geom_line(color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(color = "firebrick", size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1985, 2024, by = 5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mining Pixels Through Time (1985–2024)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mining Pixels"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16)
  )




forest_pixels <- df %>%
  filter(land_cover_1985 == "Forest Formation")

# Count Mining pixels for each year
forest_to_mining <- tibble(
  Year = 1985:2024,
  Mining_Pixels = sapply(1985:2024, function(y) {
    sum(forest_pixels[[paste0("land_cover_", y)]] == "Mining",
        na.rm = TRUE)
  })
)
# Plot
ggplot(forest_to_mining,
       aes(x = Year, y = Mining_Pixels)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick", color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1985, 2024, by = 5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Forest Formation Pixels Converted to Mining (1985–2024)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Mining Pixels"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16)
  )





forest_recovery <- df %>%
  filter(
    pre_anthropogenic_class == "Forest Formation",
    first_anthropogenic_class == "Mining",
    land_cover_2024 == "Forest Formation"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_time = return_to_pre_anthropogenic_year -
                    first_anthropogenic_year
  )

ggplot(forest_recovery,
       aes(x = recovery_time)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    fill = "forestgreen",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Recovery Time of Forest Pixels After Mining",
    x = "Years Until Return to Forest Formation",
    y = "Number of Pixels"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()





ggplot(forest_recovery,
       aes(x = recovery_time)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "forestgreen",
    color = "black",
    outlier.color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Recovery Time for Forest Pixels Remaining Forest in 2024",
    y = "Years Until Recovery"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )



summary(forest_recovery$recovery_time)

mean(forest_recovery$recovery_time)

median(forest_recovery$recovery_time)

sd(forest_recovery$recovery_time)




forest_recovery %>%
  count(return_to_pre_anthropogenic_year) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = return_to_pre_anthropogenic_year,
             y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "forestgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Forest Pixels Returning From Mining",
    x = "Recovery Year",
    y = "Recovered Pixels"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
"Recovery Time of Forest Pixels After Mining"
-How long did it take forest pixels that had successfully recovered and remained forest through 2024?
-Same as "Years Required for Mining Pixels to Recover to Forest" plus the pixel must still be Forest Formation in 2024

```{r}
# Prepare recovery data
forest_recovery_all_classes <- df %>%
  filter(
    pre_anthropogenic_class == "Forest Formation",
    !is.na(first_anthropogenic_class),
    !is.na(first_anthropogenic_year),
    !is.na(return_to_pre_anthropogenic_year)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_time = return_to_pre_anthropogenic_year -
      first_anthropogenic_year
  ) %>%
  filter(
    recovery_time >= 0,
    return_to_pre_anthropogenic_year <= 2024
  )

# Check how many recovered pixels occur in each class
forest_recovery_all_classes %>%
  count(first_anthropogenic_class, sort = TRUE)

ggplot(
  forest_recovery_all_classes,

) +

    ),

      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 9
    )
  )
```



Presidential Change and Illegal Mining 

https://news.mongabay.com/2019/12/brazil-on-the-precipice-from-environmental-leader-to-despoiler-2010-2020/?utm_source=chatgpt.com
-Under Dilma Rousseff, who served as president from January 2011 until her removal from office in August 2016, economic development increasingly took priority over environmental and Indigenous protections. The government supported large infrastructure and energy projects, including dams, roads and other initiatives intended to stimulate economic growth.
-Michel Temer became president after Rousseff’s impeachment in 2016. The article emphasizes his political reliance on the ruralista bloc, a powerful congressional coalition representing agribusiness, landowners and resource-development interests. Because Temer needed congressional support to remain in office amid corruption allegations, environmental and Indigenous protections became bargaining instruments. The article describes efforts to weaken conservation safeguards, reduce protected areas, hinder Indigenous territorial recognition and make land occupation or resource exploitation easier.
-Jair Bolsonaro’s 2018 election as an acceleration and ideological transformation of earlier trends. Bolsonaro openly criticized environmental regulation, Indigenous territorial protections and restrictions on extracting resources from the Amazon. His administration placed officials sympathetic to agribusiness and extractive development in important positions, challenged the credibility of environmental monitoring and undermined agencies responsible for protecting forests and Indigenous territories. Bolsonaro also publicly advocated opening Indigenous lands to mining.

In short:
2011–2015: weakening protections under development-oriented policies;
2016–2018: further institutional and legislative pressure under Temer;
2019–2022: rapid intensification under Bolsonaro.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)

# Replace these labels with the exact anthropogenic class names
# appearing in your dataset.
anthropogenic_classes <- c(
  "Pasture",
  "Agriculture",
  "Temporary Crop",
  "Perennial Crop",
  "Soybean",
  "Rice",
  "Other Temporary Crops",
  "Coffee",
  "Citrus",
  "Other Perennial Crops",
  "Forest Plantation",
  "Mosaic of Uses",
  "Urban Area",
  "Mining",
  "Aquaculture",
  "Other Non Vegetated Area"
)

landcover_cols <- paste0("land_cover_", 1985:2024)

# Convert annual columns from wide format to long format
landcover_long <- data %>%
  select(record_id, all_of(landcover_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(landcover_cols),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "land_cover"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(str_remove(year, "land_cover_")),

    # Keep anthropogenic classes separate and combine everything else
    plot_class = if_else(
      land_cover %in% anthropogenic_classes,
      land_cover,
      "Natural / Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(plot_class))



landcover_transitions <- landcover_long %>%
  arrange(record_id, year) %>%
  group_by(record_id) %>%
  mutate(
    next_year  = lead(year),
    next_class = lead(plot_class)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(next_class),
    next_year == year + 1
  ) %>%
  count(
    year,
    plot_class,
    next_year,
    next_class,
    name = "pixel_count"
  )


ggplot(
  landcover_transitions,
  aes(
    x = year,
    xend = next_year,
    stratum = plot_class,
    alluvium = interaction(plot_class, next_class),
    y = pixel_count,
    fill = plot_class
  )
) +
  geom_flow(
    aes(
      stratum = next_class,
      alluvium = interaction(plot_class, next_class)
    ),
    alpha = 0.55,
    color = NA,
    width = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_stratum(
    width = 0.35,
    color = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1985, 2024, by = 5),
    minor_breaks = 1985:2024
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Land-Cover Transitions Among Anthropogenic Classes",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Annual pixel transitions from 1985–2024;",
      "non-anthropogenic classes grouped as Natural / Other"
    ),
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of pixels",
    fill = "Land-cover class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)

years <- 1985:2024
landcover_cols <- paste0("land_cover_", years)

recovery_comparison <- data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    ever_mining = any(
      c_across(all_of(landcover_cols)) == "Mining",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    ever_pasture = any(
      c_across(all_of(landcover_cols)) == "Pasture",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    disturbance_class = case_when(
      ever_mining & !ever_pasture ~ "Mining",
      ever_pasture & !ever_mining ~ "Pasture",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    disturbance_year = {
      classes <- c_across(all_of(landcover_cols))

      target_class <- disturbance_class

      if (is.na(target_class)) {
        NA_integer_
      } else {
        disturbance_positions <- which(classes == target_class)

        if (length(disturbance_positions) == 0) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          years[min(disturbance_positions)]
        }
      }
    },

    return_to_forest_year = {
      classes <- c_across(all_of(landcover_cols))

      if (is.na(disturbance_year)) {
        NA_integer_
      } else {
        disturbance_position <- which(years == disturbance_year)

        # Years strictly after the first disturbance
        later_positions <- seq(
          disturbance_position + 1,
          length(classes)
        )

        forest_positions <- later_positions[
          classes[later_positions] == "Forest Formation"
        ]

        if (length(forest_positions) == 0) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          years[min(forest_positions)]
        }
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_time = return_to_forest_year - disturbance_year
  ) %>%
  filter(
    pre_anthropogenic_class == "Forest Formation",
    disturbance_class %in% c("Mining", "Pasture")
  )


recovery_comparison %>%
  group_by(disturbance_class) %>%
  summarise(
    total_disturbed_pixels = n(),
    recovered_pixels = sum(!is.na(recovery_time)),
    unrecovered_pixels = sum(is.na(recovery_time)),
    recovery_percentage = mean(!is.na(recovery_time)) * 100,
    mean_recovery_time = mean(recovery_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_recovery_time = median(recovery_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_recovery_time = sd(recovery_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


anova_data <- recovery_comparison %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(recovery_time),
    recovery_time > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disturbance_class = factor(
      disturbance_class,
      levels = c("Pasture", "Mining")
    )
  )


anova_model <- aov(
  recovery_time ~ disturbance_class,
  data = anova_data
)

summary(anova_model)


par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(
  anova_model,
  which = 1
)

plot(
  anova_model,
  which = 2
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
library(car)

leveneTest(
  recovery_time ~ disturbance_class,
  data = anova_data
)



oneway.test(
  recovery_time ~ disturbance_class,
  data = anova_data,
  var.equal = FALSE
)

t.test(
  recovery_time ~ disturbance_class,
  data = anova_data,
  var.equal = FALSE
)


library(effectsize)

eta_squared(
  anova_model,
  partial = FALSE
)


anova_data %>%
  group_by(disturbance_class) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(recovery_time),
    median = median(recovery_time),
    sd = sd(recovery_time),
    .groups = "drop"
  )





chi_data <- recovery_comparison %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_status = if_else(
      !is.na(return_to_forest_year),
      "Recovered by 2024",
      "Not recovered by 2024"
    )
  )


recovery_table <- table(
  chi_data$disturbance_class,
  chi_data$recovery_status
)

recovery_table

chi_result <- chisq.test(recovery_table)

chi_result

fisher.test(recovery_table)

library(effectsize)

cramers_v(recovery_table)

prop.table(
  recovery_table,
  margin = 1
) * 100



chi_time_data <- anova_data %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_category = case_when(
      recovery_time <= 5 ~ "1–5 years",
      recovery_time <= 10 ~ "6–10 years",
      recovery_time <= 20 ~ "11–20 years",
      TRUE ~ "More than 20 years"
    )
  )

recovery_time_table <- table(
  chi_time_data$disturbance_class,
  chi_time_data$recovery_category
)

recovery_time_table

chi_time_result <- chisq.test(recovery_time_table)

chi_time_result
chi_time_result$expected




ggplot(
  anova_data,
  aes(
    x = disturbance_class,
    y = recovery_time,
    fill = disturbance_class
  )
) +
  geom_violin(
    alpha = 0.5,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.18,
    outlier.alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  labs(

    x = "Anthropogenic disturbance",

  ) +

    legend.position = "none"
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)


years <- 1985:2024
landcover_cols <- paste0("land_cover_", years)

pasture_recovery <- data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # First year the pixel became Pasture
    first_pasture_year = {
      classes <- c_across(all_of(landcover_cols))
      pasture_positions <- which(classes == "Pasture")

      if (length(pasture_positions) == 0) {
        NA_integer_
      } else {
        years[min(pasture_positions)]
      }
    },

    # First Forest Formation year after first becoming Pasture
    return_to_forest_year = {
      classes <- c_across(all_of(landcover_cols))
      pasture_positions <- which(classes == "Pasture")

      if (length(pasture_positions) == 0) {
        NA_integer_
      } else {
        first_pasture_position <- min(pasture_positions)

        later_positions <- seq.int(
          from = first_pasture_position + 1,
          to = length(classes)
        )

        forest_positions <- later_positions[
          classes[later_positions] == "Forest Formation"
        ]

        if (length(forest_positions) == 0) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          years[min(forest_positions)]
        }
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_time = return_to_forest_year - first_pasture_year
  ) %>%
  filter(
    pre_anthropogenic_class == "Forest Formation",
    !is.na(first_pasture_year)
  )


pasture_recovery_by_year <- pasture_recovery %>%
  filter(!is.na(return_to_forest_year)) %>%
  count(
    return_to_forest_year,
    name = "pixels_recovered"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    return_to_forest_year = 1985:2024,
    fill = list(pixels_recovered = 0)
  )


ggplot(
  pasture_recovery_by_year,
  aes(
    x = return_to_forest_year,
    y = pixels_recovered
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "darkolivegreen3",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1985, 2025, by = 5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual Forest Recovery of Pasture-Disturbed Pixels",
    subtitle = paste(
      "First observed return to Forest Formation",
      "after first classification as Pasture"
    ),
    x = "Year of return to Forest Formation",
    y = "Number of pixels recovered"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```
